items.question: What were Allie Quigley's stats in her last WNBA season?
items.answer: In the 2022 regular season, Allie Quigley averaged 11.4 points, 2.5 rebounds, and 2.9 assists in 34 games for the Chicago Sky.

items.question: How long did Allie Quigley play in the WNBA?
items.answer: Allie Quigley played 14 WNBA seasons for five teams: the Phoenix Mercury, Indiana Fever, San Antonio Silver Stars, Seattle Storm and Chicago Sky. She spent 2013 to 2022 with her hometown Sky and won the 2021 WNBA championship with Chicago.

items.question: Is Allie Quigley retired?
items.answer: Yes. Allie Quigley officially announced her retirement on June 10, 2025, in an essay for The Players' Tribune. She last played in the WNBA in 2022 with the Chicago Sky.

items.question: How many times did Allie Quigley win the 3-point contest?
items.answer: Allie Quigley won the WNBA All-Star 3-Point Contest four times, in 2017, 2018, 2021 and 2022, the most in WNBA history. In 2018 she scored 29 points, a record for an All-Star 3-point competition across the NBA and WNBA.

items.question: Where did Allie Quigley go to college?
items.answer: Allie Quigley played college basketball at DePaul, where she scored 2,078 career points and averaged a team-leading 19.4 points as a senior. She made the All-Big East second team in 2008.

items.question: How old is Allie Quigley?
items.answer: Allie Quigley was born June 20, 1986, and grew up in Joliet, Illinois.

items.question: How tall is Allie Quigley?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Allie Quigley at 5 feet 10 inches and 142 pounds. She played guard.

items.question: Did Allie Quigley play for Hungary?
items.answer: Yes. Allie Quigley obtained Hungarian citizenship while playing for Pecs 2010 in Hungary and played for the Hungarian national team in qualifying for the 2013 EuroBasket.
